data.name: SsangYong / KGM windscreen replacement
data.description: Mobile SsangYong / KGM windscreen replacement across Sydney and NSW. We confirm the exact glass your SsangYong / KGM takes, arrange calibration where needed.

mainEntity.name: Can you replace a SsangYong / KGM windscreen at my home or work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and that is how we do most SsangYong / KGM jobs. We bring the glass, the urethane and the tools to the vehicle. We need room to open both front doors and somewhere reasonably sheltered if it is raining.

mainEntity.name: Does my SsangYong / KGM need the camera recalibrated after a new windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if it carries a forward-facing camera behind the glass. We confirm it from your build when you book and include it in the quote rather than adding it later. See windscreen replacement for how calibration fits into the job.

mainEntity.name: What decides the price of a SsangYong / KGM windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a SsangYong / KGM it is mostly what is built into the glass: rain sensor on later models and the like narrow the part down, and a narrower part costs more. The build year and grade decide the rest. Our cost guide explains each factor.

mainEntity.name: Can a chip in a SsangYong / KGM windscreen be repaired instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, and on a SsangYong / KGM it is worth asking early: keeping the original glass means the camera behind it never moves, so there is no calibration to arrange either. See windscreen chip repair .
